title: Fallible Conversions with TryFrom
goal: Convert integer types safely when values might exceed the target range.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 4 Afternoon: Standard Traits

hints: Converting from i32 to u8 can fail if the value is negative or larger than 255.
Propagate the Err variant early out of the function when conversion fails.
explanation: `TryInto` performs fallible conversions and returns a `Result` containing the target type or an error. Infallible `into()` triggers `E0277` because Rust prevents implicit or unsafe integer truncation. Direct casting with `as u8` produces a `u8` without a `Result`, so calling `map_err` on it fails with `E0599`.
